instruction: Build a minimal runnable OpenFAST model from scratch using only the command line: 1. Create main file `/home/user/Desktop/minimal.fst`: - Call ElastoDyn, AeroDyn v15, InflowWind, and ServoDyn - Use NREL 5MW parameters (or a simplified rigid turbine) - Time step `0.0125 s`, total duration `30 s` 2. Create module input files: - `/home/user/Desktop/minimal_elasto.dat`: rigid tower, 3 blades, initial rotor speed 9 rpm - `/home/user/Desktop/minimal_inflow.dat`: steady wind 8 m/s - `/home/user/Desktop/minimal_aero.dat`: BEMT, no tower shadow, no yaw misalignment - `/home/user/Desktop/minimal_servo.dat`: simple pitch control or fixed speed 3. Run: `openfast minimal` 4. Write a post-processing script to extract `GenPwr` from `minimal.out`, and save to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `mean_pwr_kw, max_rotor_thrust_kn` (use `RotThrust` or `RtAeroFxh`) 5. Do not use GUI tools.
